GoalOptions.Label: Strategic Grasp
GoalOptions.Text: To ensure the Board and VP Engineering fully grasp the strategic importance of our AI-driven E-Discovery platform. This includes understanding its role in market differentiation, future revenue streams, and long-term technological leadership within Legal Technology. Success means they are aligned on the vision and potential for significant market disruption.

GoalOptions.Label: Investment Justification
GoalOptions.Text: To justify continued investment in the ML Inference layer, demonstrating its critical role in achieving sub-200ms p99 latency and delivering superior E-Discovery data minimization. The goal is to secure buy-in for resource allocation, ensuring the platform's ongoing development and competitive edge. Success means approval for the next phase of development and scaling.

GoalOptions.Label: Technical Validation
GoalOptions.Text: To validate the architectural soundness and performance capabilities of the cloud-native, event-driven microservices platform and its unified AI inference layer. This includes showcasing the effectiveness of RAG, citation verification, and TAR in real-world legal scenarios. Success means the VP Engineering recognizes the technical excellence and scalability, and the Board understands the robust foundation.

GoalOptions.Label: Market Leadership
GoalOptions.Text: To position our AI-Driven E-Discovery solution as a definitive market leader, emphasizing its unique capabilities in data minimization and privilege review. The objective is to highlight how our ML inference technology sets new industry benchmarks for speed, accuracy, and compliance. Success means the stakeholders perceive our solution as a critical differentiator and a driver of market share growth.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial & Market Impact
Criteria: Board understands the projected market share growth for AI-driven E-Discovery.
VP Engineering can articulate the competitive advantage derived from sub-200ms p99 latency.
Document clearly links ML inference capabilities to new revenue opportunities.
Stakeholders are convinced of the platform's potential to disrupt traditional legal tech.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Performance Validation
Criteria: VP Engineering confirms the architectural integrity of the microservices and AI inference layer.
Document provides clear evidence of achieving sub-200ms p99 latency under load.
Board understands the scalability of the cloud-native, multi-tenant platform.
Effectiveness of RAG, citation verification, and TAR in legal contexts is clearly demonstrated.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Strategic Alignment & Risk Mitigation
Criteria: Board aligns on the strategic roadmap for AI integration in Legal Technology.
Document addresses potential technical debt or scaling challenges for the ML inference layer.
VP Engineering confirms the platform's adherence to best practices for data security and privacy.
Stakeholders understand how the solution mitigates risks associated with manual E-Discovery processes.
